title: catalog.json
description: One BIL dataset's catalog entry, written beside the store by scripts/bil-scripts/catalog_entry.py: the shape of one bil-completed.json item without entries or genes, plus provenance. Fields come from bil-merfish-datasets.csv, then a bil-completed.json, then the BIL API, later sources winning. When no source knows the code the file holds only bilCode (plus source and written_at). Producers may add fields; readers ignore what they do not know.

platform.description: As the source says it — the BIL API reports "other" for some Xenium datasets.

metadata.description: Open display bag, mirroring CatalogDataset.metadata. The keys below are the ones the BIL API fills; others may appear.

source.description: Field name -> which source supplied it.
